what: The entity registry of the graph of meaning: the people, organisations, products, models, standards, laws, places, events, sites, publications, repositories and vaults the articles name, one id each, with the names the articles use. Seeded on 18 October 2026 from a scan of proper nouns in three or more articles and the outside sites the article graphs cite; grown by the Cartographer, who adds an entity with new: true in an article's file and the next run folds it in here with its aliases. A private person is never an entity: the articles do not name them, and neither does this file.
